name: Gunjou no Yuki
source:
The protagonist Takigawa Nanase is a super normal modern day female high school student. The story starts to move when she discovers an old diary in a storehouse on the grounds of her house. When she opens the diary a strange light jumps out and she gets sucked into the book.

When she came to her senses she had arrived at a street that was completely unfamiliar and different from her modern time. Somehow she had time traveled to the Taishou Era!?

Not understanding the situation Nanase was unable to move. It was looking likely that she would be found and attacked by some suspicious men. But suddenly she was saved by a gentle hearted youth Takami Touma and his attendant Fujima Kounosuke.

By Touma's kindness, Nanase was taken under the protection of the Takami household and went to live in their mansion. But what was waiting for her there was a rather cruel fate.

"If I can change the past, I can save you? Or..."

A single girl, In an era that isn't her own, will become a strong noble woman...

(Translated from the official site)
translation:
主角多岐川 七瀬是一名极其普通的现代女高中生。故事在她于自家院内仓库发现一本旧日记时开始转动。她打开日记，一道奇异的光芒跃出，她也被吸入书中。

恢复意识后，她来到一条完全陌生、与现代截然不同的街道。她不知为何穿越到了大正时代！？

七瀬不明白眼前的状况，无法动弹。她眼看就要被几个可疑男子发现并袭击。就在这时，她被心地善良的青年鹰见 冬真及其随从藤间 孝之助救下。

由于冬真的善意，七瀬受到鹰见家的保护，住进了他们的宅邸。然而等待她的，却是一段相当残酷的命运。

“如果我能改变过去，就能救你吗？还是……”

一名少女将在不属于自己的时代，成长为坚强的贵族女子……

（译自官方网站）
